scenarios.title: A satisfied user who unchecks nothing reaches terminal

gherkin.given: a uservalidation.md whose acceptance items are all checked and which carries no Human Acceptance Record
gherkin.when: the terminal acceptance verdict is evaluated for a done transition
gherkin.then: the verdict returns 0 and emits no PD12-NO-RECORD finding

linkedTests.testId: S1-T1 SCN-B037-001: a fully checked checklist with no record reaches terminal

testMechanism.negativeControl: Restore acceptance-record.requiredAtTerminal to true; the fully checked record-less fixture is refused again with PD12-NO-RECORD.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: The acceptance verdict is a text classification over a markdown file with no route and no rendered surface.

scenarios.title: A user-reported regression still blocks terminal

gherkin.given: a uservalidation.md with five checked acceptance items and one the user has unchecked
gherkin.when: the terminal acceptance verdict is evaluated for a done transition
gherkin.then: the verdict returns non-zero and names the unchecked item in a PD12-UNCHECKED-ITEM finding

linkedTests.testId: S1-T2 SCN-B037-002 ADVERSARIAL: one unchecked item refuses terminal and is NAMED

testMechanism.negativeControl: Drop the PD12-UNCHECKED-ITEM emission; the one-unchecked fixture stops being refused and the inversion has widened into a hole.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: The acceptance verdict is a text classification over a markdown file with no route and no rendered surface.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-029 shape: two unchecked items are detected

testMechanism.negativeControl: Relax the terminal verdict to require only one checked item; the BUG-029 fixture passes and BUG-029 has reopened.
